repos_data.description: AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.

The fastest, litest AI Gateway. Rust core with Python SDK. Call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI (or native) format with cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing, and logging [Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI, VertexAI, vLLM, Nvidia NIM]

A simple, lightweight shell script to interact with OpenAI or Ollama or Mistral AI or LocalAI or ZhipuAI from the terminal, and enhancing intelligent system management without any dependencies(pure shell).

A Go toolkit for building AI agents and applications across multiple providers. Unified LLM client, agent framework with handoffs, tool calling, streaming, structured output, MCP integration, and cost tracking.
Synthetic monitoring and CI smoke tests for LLM inference endpoints.
Universal LLM API client — 163 providers, 14 native language bindings, powered by a Rust core
MCP server that adds RAG-powered AI chat to any website. One command from Claude Code. Local vector store, multi-provider LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). Zero cloud dependency.
LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.
AI pair programming in your terminal — one static binary, sub-ms startup, any model
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides access to multiple Large Language Model (LLM) APIs including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Kimi K2, and DeepSeek.
Use ChatGPT On Wechat via wechaty
Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
